description: This Java class 'AndroidConfigurationProducer' is responsible for creating and managing Android run configurations within an IDE, specifically for identifying activity classes and setting up execution contexts.

classes.name: AndroidConfigurationProducer
classes.description: A class extending JavaRunConfigurationProducerBase to produce Android run configurations based on context, primarily for launching specific activities.

methods.name: AndroidConfigurationProducer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the producer with the Android run configuration type.

methods.name: getActivityClass
methods.description: Private static method that retrieves the activity class from a given location and context by checking class inheritance.

methods.name: setupConfigurationFromContext
methods.description: Sets up an Android run configuration based on the current context, identifying the activity class and configuring parameters accordingly.

methods.name: isConfigurationFromContext
methods.description: Checks if an existing configuration matches the current context by comparing activity class and module.
